research.title: Rebuilding resilience in America’s pharmaceutical supply chain
research.summary: Alex Gorsky, former chairman and CEO of Johnson & Johnson and a member of J.P. Morgan’s SRI Advisory Council, joins Jerry Lee, global co-head of Healthcare Investment Banking and global chairman of Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan to discuss what reshoring, friendshoring and AI mean for the next decade of healthcare resiliency.
